name: jump-start
reminder: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.

expand.text: You may cast this card from your graveyard if the resulting spell is an instant or sorcery spell by discarding a card as an additional cost to cast it. If this spell was cast using jump-start, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.
